# Saralak Search

> Saralak Search is a Thailand-based SEO, AEO, GEO and AI Search consultancy led by Saralak Kaewkum.

## Core Services
- [Search Services](https://saralak-search.com/services): SEO, GEO, Local SEO, Google Maps and content services for Thai businesses.
- [รับทำ SEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/seo): Monthly SEO retainer — keyword research, on-page optimisation, technical SEO.
- [รับทำ Local SEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/local-seo): Local search visibility for businesses serving customers in a specific area.
- [รับทำ Google Maps](https://saralak-search.com/services/google-maps): Google Business Profile optimisation and Google Maps ranking.
- [รับทำ GEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/geo): Generative Engine Optimisation — making AI Search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) cite and recommend your brand.
- [รับเขียนบทความ SEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/content-marketing): SEO content writing with keyword cluster strategy for Thai businesses.
- [สอน SEO](https://saralak-search.com/services/seo-training): SEO training using the learner's own website — 1:1 online (9,900 THB), 1:1 onsite (15,000 THB), small group (25,000 THB) and in-house corporate training (from 35,000 THB).
